question: Where are the headquarters of the National Anti Doping Agency of India situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **National Anti Doping Agency (NADA) of India** has its headquarters located in **New Delhi**, the capital city of India. 
• **NADA** was established in **2005** under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports to promote clean sport and combat doping practices in India. 
• The primary role of NADA is to implement the **World Anti-Doping Code (WADC)** and ensure compliance with international standards for anti-doping activities. 
• NADA's headquarters in New Delhi serves as the central hub for managing doping control programs, athlete testing, and awareness campaigns. 
• New Delhi, as the administrative and political center of India, provides the necessary infrastructure and accessibility for NADA to coordinate with other national and international organizations. <
